english.title: Nuisance in town / village greens / allotments - Inclosure Act 1857
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[wilfully caused injury or damage to a fence of]_
(B)_[wilfully and without lawful authority lead or drove cattle on]_
(C)_[wilfully laid **(..SPECIFY MATTER OR THING LAID..) on]_
(D)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), to the injury of]_

**(..SPECIFY PLACE..), that place being

(E)_[a town green]_
(F)_[a village green]_
(G)_[land allotted and awarded under inclosure under 'The Acts for the Inclosure, Exchange and Improvement of Land']_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12 of the Inclosure Act 1857.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
wilfully caused injury / damage
to a fence of a town / village green / land OR
wilfully and without lawful authority
lead / drive cattle / animal
on to a town / village green / land OR
wilfully lay manure / soil / ashes /
rubbish / other matter / thing
on a town / village green / land OR
do another act whatsoever to the
injury of such town / village green / land OR
do another act whatsoever
on a town / village green / land to the
interruption of the use / enjoyment
as a place for exercise and recreation
